description: This file defines the ProjectService class within the OrangeHRM Time module, providing methods for managing project and activity data, including validation and data transformation.

classes.name: ProjectService
classes.description: Service class providing project and activity management operations, including validation and data mapping.

methods.name: getProjectDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ProjectDao instance.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ProjectActivityDao instance.

methods.name: validateProjectActivityName
methods.description: Validates that project activities involved in a transfer are valid, unique, and belong to the correct project, throwing exceptions if violations are detected.

methods.name: getProjectActivityAsMap
methods.description: Converts an array of ProjectActivity objects into a map keyed by activity name for quick lookups.
